metadata.description: Cursor plugins for stufently's MCP servers: each bundles the server with safe defaults and ready-made scenarios (skills, commands, rules)

plugins.name: zabbix-ai-cli-mcp
plugins.description: Ask Zabbix what is broken and why an alert fired or never arrived. Read-only by default: the bundled server starts with writes switched off.

plugins.name: google-webtools-mcp
plugins.description: Check why a page is not in Google, and get a weekly Search Console review, through the google-webtools MCP server.

plugins.name: bing-webmaster-ai-cli-mcp
plugins.description: Check whether Bing has crawled and indexed a page and review Bing search traffic. Writes are only planned for a person to apply: the bundled server starts with BING_WM_ALLOW_WRITES=false.

plugins.name: yandex-metrica-mcp
plugins.description: Traffic and goal-conversion reports from Yandex Metrica. Give it a token with the metrika:read scope only and the counter create/delete tools the server also exposes have nothing to act with.

plugins.name: aviasales-mcp
plugins.description: Find the cheapest flight for a route or a budget from Aviasales (Travelpayouts) cached fares. Read-only: the server has no tool that books or pays.

plugins.name: selectel-s3-mcp-ai-cli
plugins.description: Selectel S3 backups for Cursor: find and restore a file from a backup, see where the bucket's space goes. Read-only: the bundled server cannot write, delete or move objects.
